about: Focused scheduler regression mutants, run with their named killers. Model searches reserve all scheduler slots for memory isolation.

mutants.name: b15-r8-run-memory-reservation-disconnected
mutants.rule: The running gate connects MemoryHeavy to an exclusive slot reservation.

mutants.name: b15-r7-model-memory-unreserved
mutants.rule: Every model search declares a full-gate memory reservation.

mutants.name: b15-r7-memory-slot-undercharged
mutants.rule: A queued memory-heavy step reserves all requested slots, not one.

mutants.name: b15-r7-memory-immediate-undercharged
mutants.rule: An immediate memory-heavy reservation also takes all requested slots.

mutants.name: gateex-examples-step-uncounted
mutants.rule: The fast-tier CPU budget counts the examples step.

mutants.name: gateex-step-recorded-as-package
mutants.rule: -record-durations -fast records a budgeted step under its step name.

mutants.name: tc-gate-managed-go
mutants.rule: A gate step's ergo builds with the system go and never downloads Go, unless the caller sets ERGO_GO.

mutants.name: b18-full-tier-package-unrecognized
mutants.rule: A package whose every test builds Go (each Test function starts with needsBuild) has no fast-tier step, so a checker edit does not compile, link and start its test binary to skip every test.

mutants.name: b18-full-tier-package-stepped
mutants.rule: The fast tier declares no step for a full-tier-only package (fullTierOnly).

mutants.name: b17-fast-all-large-stepped
mutants.rule: A package whose every test is large has no fast step, so it costs the fast budget nothing.

mutants.name: gf3-shards-dealt-by-wall
mutants.rule: A package with recorded CPU rows deals its shards by CPU, not wall time.

mutants.name: gf3-hang-floor-at-go-default
mutants.rule: No go test step's deadline is go test's 15 minute default.

mutants.name: gf3-build-step-without-deadline
mutants.rule: Every go test command of a step passes -timeout.

mutants.name: gf3-shard-deadline-ignores-cost
mutants.rule: A shard's deadline is ten times its recorded cost.

mutants.name: gf3-pause-keeps-the-span
mutants.rule: A paused test's wait is not its CPU.

mutants.name: gate-key-stale-binary
mutants.origin: wf10 FU-b18 (batch-18 verify, gate start key)
mutants.from: entries = slices.DeleteFunc(entries, func(e replay.Entry) bool { return gateOutput(e.Path, e.Class) })
mutants.rule: No key holds the gate's own outputs (bin/): a gate started on a stale bin/ergo, which its build rewrites, still records.

mutants.name: gate-replay-stale-binary
mutants.origin: wf10 FU-b18 r2 (orchestrator: a replay leaves a stale bin/ergo)
mutants.rule: After a whole-gate replay the gate builds its outputs again, so bin/ergo matches the tree.

mutants.name: gate-prescope-replay-stale-binary
mutants.origin: wf10 FU-b18 r2 (orchestrator: a replay leaves a stale bin/ergo)
mutants.rule: The replay before the scope builds bin/ergo again, so the binary matches the tree.

mutants.name: sandbox-ready-fixed-limit
mutants.origin: wf10 FU-b18 r2 (no fixed run limits in scripts/gate)
mutants.from:
case <-tick.C:
			if pid := childPid.Load(); pid != 0 && processEnded(int(pid)) {
mutants.to:
case <-time.After(time.Millisecond):
			err, waiting = errors.New("the export took too long"), false
		case <-tick.C:
			if pid := childPid.Load(); pid != 0 && processEnded(int(pid)) {
mutants.rule: The sandbox's start waits for an event (ready, or its first process ended), never for a fixed time: a fixed bound fails an export that is still running (a 1 ms bound stands for a loaded host).

mutants.name: sandbox-first-process-unwatched
mutants.origin: wf10 FU-b18 r2 (no fixed run limits in scripts/gate)
mutants.to: if pid := childPid.Load(); false && pid != 0 && processEnded(int(pid)) {
mutants.rule: A sandbox whose first process fails is a failure at once: with no time bound on the start, the watch of that process is what ends the wait (killed by the test's deadline, which names TestMergeTierFailsClosed/bwrap_fails_to_mount).
